change: resolving a memory conflict no longer deletes the replaced version: it is saved as a candidate first, and the label changed from 冲突版本 to 待定版本
steps_verified: probe created a conflict (base vs remote) and the detail showed 1 个待定版本
adopting the remote version changed the memory content to 'conflict remote value'
the detail then still offered 1 个待定版本 whose content was 'conflict base value'
adopting that switched the content back to 'conflict base value'
limitations: each switch appends an audit event; there is no distinct undo action
candidate list order is by clock string, not by recency
